project_info.title: Ilya Daniliuk - Senior Business Development & Technology Portfolio
project_info.language_framework: React js (.js / .jsx), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI primitives, Framer Motion, Lucide Icons

theme.vibe: Executive Tech Leader, Confident, Intelligent, High-Precision
theme.description: Obsidian & Deep Graphite foundation (#090D16) paired with Alabaster text (#F8FAFC), crisp 1px borders (#1E293B), Electric Cobalt accent (#3B82F6), and subtle Emerald gain indicators (#10B981). Clean typography, generous padding, zero clutter.

typography.heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk / Plus Jakarta Sans / Outfit
rules: DO NOT use Inter for main headings. Use display/sans fonts like Plus Jakarta Sans or Outfit with tracking-tight.
H1 (Hero Heading): text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight. Ceiling is text-6xl.
H2 (Section Heading): text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight
Labels & Tags: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-400 font-mono

project_previews.title: Enterprise AI Pipeline Predictor & Lead Intelligence
B2B SaaS Ecosystem Integration & Partner Portal

structure_and_components.central_data_config: All portfolio information (bio, skills, projects, certifications, work timeline, social links) MUST reside in /app/frontend/src/constants/portfolioData.js for zero-code updates.

sections.description: Sticky floating navigation bar with backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-950/80, 1px bottom border, brand logo 'Ilya Daniliuk', nav links (Home, About, Core Value, Projects, Certifications, Experience, Contact), CTAs 'Download CV' and 'Get in Touch'.

Bold executive landing banner. Includes Ilya Daniliuk's name, professional headline ('Business Development Manager | Cloud, SaaS & Technology Partnerships'), 2-3 line value proposition, primary CTAs ('View Projects' + 'Download CV' modal trigger), social links (LinkedIn, GitHub, Email), and a executive metric grid ($12M+ ARR Pipeline, Multi-Cloud Certified, 15+ Enterprise Deals).

Executive bio connecting commercial deal-making with technical/cloud hands-on experience. Highlighting customer trust, C-level stakeholder alignment, and modern software/AI background with interactive highlight cards.

3-column structured grid grouping competencies into: 1. Commercial & Business Development, 2. Technology & Cloud Architecture, 3. Business Transformation & Problem Solving. Each group features detailed bullet points and visual badges.

Bento-style project cards displaying screenshot preview, summary, problem statement, what was built, tech stack pills, commercial impact, GitHub links, and a 'Deep-Dive Case Study' button that opens a comprehensive Shadcn Dialog Modal.

Cards grouped logically by issuer (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Security & Agile). Displays certification title, issuer, date earned, credential ID, direct verification link button, and core skills validated.
Vertical interactive timeline showing career history, roles, companies, dates, and 2-3 metric-driven achievements per role with expandable details.
Contact panel featuring direct LinkedIn, GitHub, Email links, meeting scheduler CTA, and a responsive contact form with input validation and Sonner toast notification on submission.
Minimalist footer with copyright, navigation quick links, smooth scroll 'Back to Top' button, and open graph/metadata setup.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy (py-20 lg:py-28 for main sections, gap-8 to gap-12 in grids).
general_ui_ux_guidelines.testing_attributes: EVERY interactive element (buttons, links, form inputs, modal triggers, tab buttons, social links) MUST include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-download-cv-button', data-testid='nav-link-projects', data-testid='contact-form-submit-button').
general_ui_ux_guidelines.animations: Subtle entrance animations using Framer Motion (fade-up, staggerChildren). Micro-hover state transitions on cards (translate-y-1, border-highlight glow). Exclude transform from universal transition css rules.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.accessibility: High contrast text (WCAG AA compliant), clear focus-visible rings (ring-2 ring-blue-500), ARIA labels on social links and icon buttons.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.modals_and_toasts: Use Shadcn Dialog component for project case-study details and CV view/download modal. Use Sonner for contact form submission toasts.
